name: autoclip
description: AutoClip｜一个链接，一键出片。开源 AI 视频剪辑桌面工具，将播客、访谈、课程等长视频自动剪成短视频，生成字幕、封面和发布文案，适配抖音、小红书、TikTok、Reels 与 YouTube Shorts。Open-source AI video clipping & content repurposing.
one_liner: An AI tool that takes a long podcast, interview, or livestream and automatically cuts it into short, captioned clips ready to post on TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube Shorts.
buyer: A podcast host or small content agency that knows short clips drive growth but doesn't have hours to manually re-edit every episode.
business_use_cases: A podcast production agency runs every client episode through it to generate a week's worth of short-form clips automatically, cutting editing costs.
A solo YouTuber turns long livestreams into daily short clips without hiring an editor.
A social media manager turns a company executive's long talks and webinars into bite-sized LinkedIn/TikTok content.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a 'done for you' short-form clipping service for podcasters, run on this tool, billed per episode.
Build a hosted SaaS wrapper around it and sell monthly clip-generation plans to creators.

steal_this: Offer three podcasters a free trial week of auto-generated clips from their back catalog, then convert them to a $50-100/month clipping subscription.
